name: agent-harness
description: Design agent recipe bundles that conform to the Agent Harness Profile 0.1: an Oracle Agent Spec agent, tool permissions, human approvals, a Cedar policy, and acceptance tests.

interface.longDescription: Turns a short description of an agent's job into a recipe bundle that conforms to the Agent Harness Profile 0.1: an Oracle Agent Spec 26.3.1 agent, tool classification, human approval rules, a Cedar policy, Agent Skills, and acceptance samples including a prompt-injection test. Instruction-only: it writes files in the recipe directory you choose and does not change your Codex settings.
defaultPrompt: Design an agent harness for a reception agent that answers website enquiries.
Review this recipe bundle against the Agent Harness Profile.
